{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS067 |prevtitle=Can You Diglett? |nextcode=PS069 |nexttitle=Playing Horsea |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Jigglypuff Jive |title_ja=VSプリン |title_ro=VS Purin |image=PS068.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 68 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|6}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 28 in [[Challenge Accepted]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 68 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|6}} |location=[[Cerise Island]] }} '''Jigglypuff Jive''' (Japanese: '''VSプリン''' ''VS {{tt|Purin|Jigglypuff}}'') is the 68th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 28th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Adv|Red}} tries to lure [[Lorelei]] and [[Agatha]] out so that they might become distracted and let it slip how they are controlling [[Bruno]] by having [[Aero]] hold onto Red and {{m|Fly}} up. Lorelei's {{p|Jynx}} uses its long hair to wrap around Red, restraining him from the outside. Red tells Lorelei that he does not know where {{Adv|Giovanni}} is, the same going for Giovanni's {{Badge|Earth}}. Lorelei says that "your eyes tell me that you are not lying". Jynx then puts Red down and Lorelei tells Red that they had another reason for bringing him there: they want him to join them. Red refuses, and sends out [[Gyara]], [[Saur]], and [[Snor]]. Agatha sends out {{p|Gastly}} and Bruno (still controlled) sends out {{p|Hitmonlee}}. With the power of the Badge Energy Amplifier, they (Lorelei's Jynx included) do a combination attack of {{t|Ice}}, {{t|Fighting}}, and {{t|Ghost}} powers, which knock out Gyara, Saur, and Snor. Lorelei's Jynx creates an ice doll that is a model of Red. Lorelei puts lipstick '×'s on the ice doll's wrists and ankles, with ice handcuffs appearing on Red in those same places, immobilizing Red's feet and hands. Lorelei also puts lipstick '×'s on an ice doll of [[Pika]]. Agatha's Gastly cloaks [[Mt. Moon|the mountain they are on]] in a mist of illusion. Their work done, Lorelei and Agatha teleport away. To defend himself from Bruno, Red sends out Pika, whose paws are immediately ice-handcuffed. Red puts his foot on a weak rock, which crumbles under him. Red manages to hold onto a rock sticking out, and tells Pika to run away, find someplace warm, and return to [[Pallet Town]]. Pika starts to run, with Hitmonlee chasing it. Red, happy that one of his Pokémon can be safe, drops to the ground. He says that Pika can't tell anyone what happened, and says, "If only there were a {{pkmn|Trainer}} who could read your thoughts...," and freezes. Pika wakes up on [[Cerise Island]], with Yellow wondering what Pika was trying to tell him. ==Major events== * [[Pika]] continues his dream of the events on how {{adv|Red}} got frozen. ** [[Lorelei]] and [[Agatha]] try to recruit Red with them. ** Red refuses and is turned into ice. ** Pika escapes from the [[Elite Four]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} * {{adv|Bill}} * [[Lorelei]] * [[Bruno]] * [[Agatha]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poliwrath}} ([[Poli]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Saur]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Snorlax}} ([[Snor]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Gyarados}} ([[Gyara]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Aerodactyl}} ([[Aero]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Jigglypuff}} ([[Jiggly]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Jynx}} ([[Lorelei]]'s) * {{p|Hitmonlee}} ([[Bruno]]'s) * {{p|Gastly}} ([[Agatha]]'s) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== [[File:PS068 error.png|thumb|100px|Jynx's missing speech balloon.]] * On page 45 of the [[VIZ Media]] second edition and digital edition, when Bruno, Agatha, and Lorelei are calling out their Pokémon, the balloon where Jynx's name should be is blank. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 胖丁|VS Jigglypuff}} |cs=Vs.
